reading: Netanyahu's coalition, a group of parties governing together, lost its majority in Israel's election.
Final results showed that neither Netanyahu's bloc, or political group, nor the main Jewish opposition won more than half the seats in parliament.
The two Arab party lists won a record 19 of parliament's 120 seats following a sharp rise in turnout among Arab voters.
Netanyahu's bloc won 53 seats, while the bloc led by his rival Gadi Eisenkot won 48.
These figures could give the Arab parties an important role in deciding who forms the next government.
Likud, Netanyahu's party, accused the Arab-led parties of stealing the election.
The possibility of illegal funding from Qatar and Turkey is being investigated by Israel's home security agency, Shin Bet.
Qatar denied the allegations and accused Israeli politicians of spreading false information about the country.
Both Arab parties rejected the claim of wrongdoing, and the Joint List said it had no basis.
The agency later clarified that its investigation did not accuse an entire community whose members had voted legally.
An election official said there was no basis for claims of a pattern of actions breaking rules protecting fair elections.
Eisenkot said it was too early to know whether anything had happened and accused Netanyahu of trying to weaken trust in the results.
Netanyahu's critics said he was trying to prevent Eisenkot from agreeing to join forces with the Arab parties.

vocabulary.definition: A group of political parties that work together to govern.
More than half of the total, here referring to seats in parliament.
The number or percentage of people who vote in an election.
Said that someone had done something wrong, without necessarily proving it.
Money provided to pay for an activity or organisation.
Claims that someone has done something wrong which have not been proved.
A process of carefully examining information to find out what happened.
Work together to achieve a shared aim.

entries.de: Eine Gruppe politischer Parteien, die zusammenarbeiten, um zu regieren.

entries.pt-BR: Mais da metade do total; aqui se refere às cadeiras no parlamento.
entries.fr: Plus de la moitié du total ; ici, il s’agit des sièges au parlement.

entries.ja: 誰かが悪いことをしたと述べたが、それを証明したとは限らない。
entries.ko: 누군가가 잘못된 일을 했다고 말했지만, 반드시 이를 입증한 것은 아님.

entries.pt-BR: Disse que alguém havia feito algo errado, sem necessariamente provar isso.
entries.fr: A affirmé que quelqu’un avait fait quelque chose de mal, sans nécessairement le prouver.
entries.de: Behauptete, dass jemand etwas Unrechtes getan hatte, ohne dies unbedingt zu beweisen.

entries.ja: 活動や組織の費用をまかなうために提供されるお金。
entries.ko: 활동이나 조직에 드는 비용을 충당하기 위해 제공되는 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 为支付某项活动或某个组织的费用而提供的资金。

entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro fornecido para cobrir os custos de uma atividade ou organização.
entries.fr: De l’argent fourni pour couvrir les dépenses d’une activité ou d’une organisation.
entries.de: Geld, das zur Deckung der Kosten einer Tätigkeit oder einer Organisation bereitgestellt wird.

entries.ja: 誰かが悪いことをしたという、まだ証明されていない主張。

entries.zh-Hans: 声称某人做了错事、但尚未得到证实的说法。
entries.es: Afirmaciones no demostradas de que alguien ha hecho algo malo.
entries.pt-BR: Afirmações de que alguém fez algo errado e que ainda não foram comprovadas.
entries.fr: Des affirmations non prouvées selon lesquelles quelqu’un a fait quelque chose de mal.
entries.de: Behauptungen, dass jemand etwas Unrechtes getan hat, die bisher nicht bewiesen wurden.

entries.ja: 何が起きたのかを明らかにするために、情報を注意深く調べる過程。
entries.ko: 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아내기 위해 정보를 면밀히 살펴보는 과정.

entries.de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem Informationen sorgfältig geprüft werden, um herauszufinden, was geschehen ist.

entries.de: Zusammenarbeiten, um ein gemeinsames Ziel zu erreichen.
